nlc26.title.en: Splitting heaven and earth with an AI axe — how VocabSummit got built
nlc26.title.zh: 挥舞AI之斧开天辟地 —— 词山学海的创作现场

nlc26.epigraphSrc.en: Lu Xun, My Old Home · this community’s motto
nlc26.epigraphSrc.zh: 鲁迅《故乡》· 本学习社群的题词

nlc26.handsTitle.en: Hands-on: turn what you already have into an interactive game
nlc26.handsTitle.zh: 动手环节：把手上的资源变成互动游戏

nlc26.handsLede.en: Excel → Claude → GitHub Pages. No coding background needed.
nlc26.handsLede.zh: Excel → Claude → GitHub Pages。（零编码基础可操作！）

nlc26.stuck1.en: Blank page, or a message saying something looks wrong with the sheet: it names the line. Almost always a missing comma, quote, or brace.
nlc26.stuck1.zh: 页面空白，或跳出「词语表好像有点问题」：提示会写第几行。九成是少了逗号、引号或大括号。

nlc26.stuck2.en: Can't find Claude's file: look in Downloads, then drag it back into the game folder.
nlc26.stuck2.zh: 找不到 Claude 给的文件：看「下载 / Downloads」资料夹，再拖回游戏资料夹。

nlc26.stuck3.en: GitHub Pages shows 404: it needs a minute or two after Save. Then hard refresh, Cmd+Shift+R or Ctrl+F5.
nlc26.stuck3.zh: GitHub Pages 是 404：按了 Save 之后要等一两分钟。然后强制刷新（Cmd+Shift+R / Ctrl+F5）。

nlc26.stackLede.en: A development team of one. So how does it run six roles?
nlc26.stackLede.zh: 一人开发团队，怎么会有六个岗位？

nlc26.p1Cycle.en: decides what to build, and what counts as built well
nlc26.p1Cycle.zh: 决定做什么、什么算做好

nlc26.p1A.en: What to build, who it is for, and what counts as getting it right.
nlc26.p1A.zh: 做什么、给谁用、怎样才算做对了。

nlc26.p2Cycle.en: works out what is being built, and writes it down
nlc26.p2Cycle.zh: 理清来龙去脉，写下规格

nlc26.p2A.en: Decisions, notes and word lists in one Project, so you never explain twice.
nlc26.p2A.zh: 设计决定、教学笔记、词表都放同一个 Project，不必每次重讲。

nlc26.p2Guide.zh: 什么是 Project · Anthropic 帮助中心

nlc26.p3A.en: It reads the files itself, edits, runs them, then checks its own work.
nlc26.p3A.zh: 它自己读文件、动手改、跑起来，再看对不对。

nlc26.p3Guide.zh: Claude Code 快速上手 · Anthropic 文档

nlc26.p4Cycle.en: draws it, and makes the artwork

nlc26.p4A.en: The cliff, the landscape, the climber: all generated.
nlc26.p4A.zh: 游戏里的山壁、风景、角色，全是生成的。

nlc26.p4Guide.en: Creating images in ChatGPT · OpenAI help
nlc26.p4Guide.zh: 在 ChatGPT 里出图 · OpenAI 帮助中心

nlc26.q1.en: Where does student data go, and is it compliant?
nlc26.q1.zh: 学生数据放在哪里？合规吗？

nlc26.q1A.en: It depends what you build. Today's game collects nothing: no sign-in, no server, and nothing left behind when a student closes the page. A version like that has no data question at all.
nlc26.q1A.zh: 看你做什么。今天这个游戏什么都不收：没有登录、没有服务器，学生关掉网页就什么都不留。这种版本没有数据问题。

nlc26.q1B.en: The moment you add accounts and saved progress, the data sits on somebody else's servers. Which region it sits in, who can read it, and how long it is kept all have to follow school and MOE rules.
nlc26.q1B.zh: 一旦加上账号和进度储存，数据就落在第三方的服务器上。存在哪个地区、谁读得到、保存多久，都要照学校和教育部的规定走。

nlc26.q1C.en: The order that works: build the version that collects nothing, put it to use, and take up compliance only when you genuinely need to track progress. The other way round tends to stall for months.
nlc26.q1C.zh: 行得通的顺序是：先做不收数据的版本，先用起来，等到真的需要追踪进度了，再去谈合规。反过来做，往往一拖好几个月。

nlc26.q2.en: With no IT support, who maintains this later?
nlc26.q2.zh: 没有 IT 支援，以后谁来维护？

nlc26.q2A.en: A static page, which is HTML plus pictures, needs almost no maintenance. On GitHub Pages it will still open years from now, untouched.
nlc26.q2A.zh: 一个静态网页（就是 HTML 加图片）几乎不用维护。放在 GitHub Pages 上，几年不动它也照样能开。

nlc26.q2B.en: The kind that needs maintaining is the other kind: accounts, a database, sign-in. That is the practical reason not to add them unless you must.
nlc26.q2B.zh: 需要维护的是另一类：有账号、有数据库、要登录的。这正是「能不加就不加」的现实理由。

nlc26.q2C.en: With the code on GitHub rather than on your laptop, a colleague can pick it up after you transfer. Far safer than a folder on your own desktop.
nlc26.q2C.zh: 代码放在 GitHub 上而不是你的手提电脑里，你调职了同事也接得下去。这比存在自己桌面上的文件夹安全得多。

nlc26.q3.en: Will this work on a school-issued laptop?
nlc26.q3.zh: 学校发的电脑做得到吗？

nlc26.q3A.en: Today's hands-on will. It needs a browser and a plain text editor, and every machine already has both.
nlc26.q3A.zh: 今天的动手环节可以。只需要一个浏览器和一个纯文本编辑器，这两样每台电脑本来就有。

nlc26.q3B.en: The step that needs an install, running Claude Code on the machine itself, may be blocked on a managed device. Use the web version instead, or your own device.
nlc26.q3B.zh: 要安装软件的那一步（在本机跑 Claude Code）在受管制的设备上可能装不了。可以改用网页版，或者用自己的设备。

nlc26.q3C.en: School networks sometimes block github.com. Known in advance it is just a different route; discovered on the spot it is a panic.
nlc26.q3C.zh: 学校网络有时候会挡 github.com。事先知道，就只是换个方法；当场才发现，就会慌。

nlc26.q4.en: I cannot code at all. Can I really do this?
nlc26.q4.zh: 我完全不会编码，真的做得到吗？

nlc26.q4A.en: Today's hands-on, yes. It was designed from the start for someone who cannot code.
nlc26.q4A.zh: 今天这个动手环节可以。它从一开始就是照着「不会编码的人」来设计的。

nlc26.q4B.en: Building something the size of VocabSummit does not need coding ability either. It needs the willingness to keep saying clearly what you want, and the judgment to tell whether what came back is right. Teachers do both every day.
nlc26.q4B.zh: 做一个像词山学海那样规模的东西，需要的也不是编码能力，而是「愿意反复把要什么讲清楚」加上「判断做出来的东西对不对」。这两件事教师每天都在做。

nlc26.dVenue.zh: 地点 · 中正中学（总校）

nlc26.dAudience.en: Audience · the 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC: 13 clusters, 16 schools, 18 Secondary Chinese Language teachers
nlc26.dAudience.zh: 对象 · 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC：13个学区、16所学校、18位中学华文教师

nlc26.dSpeaker.en: Speaker · Chun Kai Xin, Head of Mother Tongue, Bukit View Secondary School
nlc26.dSpeaker.zh: 主讲 · 郑凯欣，百德中学母语部主任

nlc26.stuck4.en: The school network blocks github.com or claude.ai: phone hotspot, or do it at home. You do not need Claude either: open my-words.js in Notepad or TextEdit and type your words straight in.
nlc26.stuck4.zh: 学校网络挡住 github.com 或 claude.ai：用手机热点，或回家再弄。不用 Claude 也行：用记事本或「文本编辑」打开 my-words.js，直接把词语打进去。

nlc26.storyTitle.en: Splitting heaven and earth out of chaos. When you can do none of it, where do you begin?
nlc26.storyTitle.zh: 在一片混沌中开天辟地。在什么都不会的时候，到底怎么开始？

nlc26.storyCap.en: The first message I sent Claude:

nlc26.storyP2.en: What I asked for was an SLS HTML5 interactive package. Building it, I found the idea would not fit inside SLS's existing structure. Step by step, it grew into what is now VocabSummit.
nlc26.storyP2.zh: 我要的本来是一个 SLS HTML5 互动课件，却边做边发现这个构想装不进 SLS 现有的架构里。于是它一步一步，长成了今天的“词山学海”。

nlc26.shot1.en: The landing page, and where the name comes from
nlc26.shot1.zh: 首页 · 「词山学海」这个名字的由来

nlc26.shot2.en: The climb: each unit is a stretch of mountain, and progress is altitude
nlc26.shot2.zh: 攀登 · 每个单元是一段山路，进度则是海拔

nlc26.storyClose.en: The move, over and over: say what you want, look at what it made, then say what needs adjusting.
nlc26.storyClose.zh: 反复的动作：说清楚要什么，看它做出什么，再说哪里要调整。

approach.needsTitle.en: Motivation has to be designed, not hoped for
approach.needsTitle.zh: 动机要设计，不能光指望学生自觉

approach.need1Voice.en: “I am forced to learn Mother Tongue.”

approach.need1Q.en: How does a student feel they are the one deciding?
approach.need1Q.zh: 怎样让学生觉得这件事是自己做主？

approach.need2Voice.en: “I keep doing badly in Mother Tongue.”

approach.need2Q.en: How do they see themselves managing it, often enough to believe it?
approach.need2Q.zh: 怎样让他们常常看见自己做得到，常到自己都信？

approach.need3Voice.en: “Nobody close to me uses Mother Tongue outside class.”
approach.need3Voice.zh: 「我身边的人，下了课没人用母语。」

approach.need3Q.en: How does practising stop being something you do on your own?
approach.need3Q.zh: 怎样让练习不再是一个人的事？

approach.needsClose.en: This is the argument I put to the school leadership in August 2026.
approach.needsClose.zh: 这就是 2026 年 8 月我跟校领导讲的那一套。

nlc26.goal1.en: Understand that delivering the prototype stage of design thinking no longer depends on coding ability: it depends on stating the requirement clearly, then judging what comes back and refining it.
nlc26.goal1.zh: 理解设计思考中「原型」落实不再依靠编码能力，而是要能把要求讲清楚，再判断成果，并进行优化

nlc26.goal2.en: Understand what Claude and GitHub each do, and how the work divides between them.
nlc26.goal2.zh: 理解 Claude 与 GitHub 各自的功能与分工

nlc26.goal3.en: Prototype: create your own GitHub repo, copy a small game and publish it live.
nlc26.goal3.zh: 做出原型：创建自己的 GitHub Repo，复制一款小游戏并发布上线

nlc26.goal4.en: (Stretch goal) Iterate the prototype: iterate the game by talking to Claude, play it, and publish it live.
nlc26.goal4.zh: （伸展目标）迭代原型：通过与 Claude 对话迭代游戏原型，试玩并发布上线

nlc26.p5A.en: Every change leaves a record, and a bad one can be rolled back.
nlc26.p5A.zh: 每一次改动都留下记录，改坏了退得回去。

nlc26.p5B.en: GitHub Pages turns it into a link for nothing.
nlc26.p5B.zh: GitHub Pages 免费把它变成网址。

nlc26.p5Guide.zh: GitHub Pages 快速上手 · GitHub 文档

nlc26.handsFloor.en: Which of these will you take on today?
nlc26.handsFloor.zh: 今天你希望接下哪些挑战呢？

nlc26.s1P1.en: github.com → Sign up. A free account.

nlc26.s1P2.en: github.com/new → name it VocabClimbStarter, or anything you like → Public → Create repository.
nlc26.s1P2.zh: github.com/new → 仓库名用 VocabClimbStarter，亦可自定义 → 选 Public → Create repository。

nlc26.s1P3.en: Open my starter → green Code button → Download ZIP → unzip.
nlc26.s1P3.zh: 打开我的示范项目 → 绿色的 Code 按钮 → Download ZIP → 解压。

nlc26.s1P4.en: Back in your repository → uploading an existing file (once it has files in it, use the + beside the green Code button → Upload files) → drag in every file you unzipped, the three pictures included → scroll to the bottom and Commit changes.
nlc26.s1P4.zh: 回到你的仓库 → 点 uploading an existing file（仓库里已经有东西了，就点绿色 Code 按钮左边的「+」→ Upload files）→ 把解压后的文件全部拖进去，三张图也要 → 拉到页面最下面按 Commit changes。

nlc26.s1Shot.en: The + sits just left of the green Code button. Upload files is inside it.
nlc26.s1Shot.zh: 「+」就在绿色 Code 按钮的左边，点开就有 Upload files。

nlc26.s1P5.en: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → main → / (root) → Save. Wait a minute or two.
nlc26.s1P5.zh: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → 选 main → 选 /(root) → Save。等一两分钟。

nlc26.s1P6.en: https://yourusername.github.io/VocabClimbStarter/ is live. The words in it are still mine, but it is already a link a student can open. That is this stage finished.
nlc26.s1P6.zh: https://你的用户名.github.io/VocabClimbStarter/ 活了。里面还是我的示范词语，但它已经是一个学生打得开的网址。到这里就算完成。

nlc26.s2P1.en: The folder has an .xlsx template. Two columns: the word, and its meaning. Row 1 stays as it is. Eight entries or more, and you never write the wrong answers yourself: the game generates the distractors from your own list.
nlc26.s2P1.zh: 资料夹里有「词语表模板.xlsx」。两栏：词语、释义。第一行不需修改。8 个以上，错误选项不用自己写，程序会参考词语表自动生成干扰项。

nlc26.s2P2.en: claude.ai → Projects → new one. Upload the whole folder and your filled-in sheet. Claude has to see the original format to know what it is matching.
nlc26.s2P2.zh: claude.ai → Projects → 新建一个。把整个资料夹和你填好的词语表都上传进去。Claude 得看见原本的格式，才知道要照着什么写。

nlc26.s2P3.en: Put Claude's my-words.js back in the folder, replacing the old one. Double-click index.html and play a round. This checking step is the actual skill.
nlc26.s2P3.zh: 把 Claude 给你的 my-words.js 放回资料夹，覆盖原来那个。双击 index.html，先自己玩一局。这一步的检查，才是真正要学的本事。

nlc26.s2P4.en: Back in your repository, open my-words.js → the pencil icon → select all, delete, paste in what Claude gave you → Commit changes. Refresh the link and your students are playing your words.
nlc26.s2P4.zh: 回你的仓库，点开 my-words.js → 铅笔图标 → 全选删掉、整段贴上 → Commit changes。刷新网址，学生玩的就是你的词语了。

nlc26.s3P1.en: Three pictures: landscape.jpg behind everything, wall.jpg for the cliff, climber.png for the climber. Swap the files, keep the names, and it just works.
nlc26.s3P1.zh: 三张图：landscape.jpg 是远景，wall.jpg 是崖壁，climber.png 是攀登者。换掉文件、名字不变，就换好了。

nlc26.s3P2.en: Then look at it on your own phone. Whether your students can make it out is a judgment only you can make.
nlc26.s3P2.zh: 换好后拿自己的手机看一看：学生看不看得清，只有你判断得了。

nlc26.s4P1.en: Open a new Project. Start with who your students are, what material you already have, and the learning goal you are after.
nlc26.s4P1.zh: 开一个新的 Project。先说你学生是谁、你手上现成有什么材料、你希望达到的学习目标。

nlc26.s4P2.en: Ask for three different approaches before it builds anything, then pick one of the three.
nlc26.s4P2.zh: 先让它给三个不一样的做法，别急着让它动手，再从三个里挑一个。

nlc26.s4P3.en: Keep refining until you are happy with it.

nlc26.stuck5.zh: 改坏了：打开那个文件 → History → 找到最后一次正常的版本 → 复制回来 → Commit changes。GitHub 网页没有「一键退回」，但每个旧版本都留着，详细步骤见课后教程。
nlc26.stuck5.en: Broke it: open the file → History → the last version that worked → copy it back → Commit changes. The GitHub website has no one-click undo, but every old version is kept; the guide has the full steps.

nlc26.stuck6.en: The starter is MIT licensed: adapt it, use it in class, rebuild it for another subject. Keep the attribution. The artwork comes with it.
nlc26.stuck6.zh: 示范项目 MIT 许可：自由改编、用于课堂、改成别科都可以，保留署名即可。美术素材一并提供。

nlc26.p6Guide.en: Get started with Firebase Authentication · Firebase docs
nlc26.p6Guide.zh: Firebase 身份验证入门 · Firebase 文档

nlc26.cycleReturn.zh: 然后回到第一步。这个循环，我做了四个月。
nlc26.cycleReturn.en: Then back to the first step. Four months of this.

nlc26.evoTitle.zh: 一个粗糙的开始，就是最好的开始
nlc26.evoTitle.en: A rough start is the best kind of start

nlc26.evoLede.zh: 下面四张图，是同一个东西的四个月。第一张丑得很实在，但它能用，所以学生用了，所以我知道下一步该改哪里。
nlc26.evoLede.en: Four pictures, four months, one thing. The first is honestly ugly. But it ran, so students used it, so I knew what to fix next.

nlc26.evo2.zh: 主页。992 个词语，四张年级卡片，没有插图，没有关卡，什么都没有。但进度条是真的会动的。
nlc26.evo2.en: The home screen. 992 words, four year-level cards, no art, no levels, nothing. But the progress bar was real.

nlc26.evo4.zh: 第十天。改名「词王淬炼坊」，加了成就、排行榜、身份分流。词语从 992 涨到 1068，因为学生开始提意见了。
nlc26.evo4.en: Day ten. Renamed, with badges, a leaderboard and separate roles. The word count had grown from 992 to 1,068, because students had started asking for words.

nlc26.evo5.zh: 四个月后重起炉灶：「词山学海」的第一天。四座山峰对应四个课程源流，山还是纯色块画的。但结构已经是今天这一版的结构了。
nlc26.evo5.en: Four months on, rebuilt from nothing: VocabSummit, day one. Four peaks for four course streams, the mountains still drawn in flat colour. The structure is already today's structure.

nlc26.evo6.zh: 今天。同一个版式、同一副对联、同一个页脚，只是画好了。上面那张和这张之间，隔的不是灵感，是一百七十多次修改。
nlc26.evo6.en: Today. Same layout, same couplet, same footer as the frame before it. Only the drawing changed. What sits between the two is not inspiration; it is a hundred and seventy-odd revisions.

nlc26.evoPlay.zh: 打开 2026 年 4 月 10 日的第一版

nlc26.evoPlayNote.zh: 这不是截图，是当天上传的那个文件本身。随便点，进度只存在你自己的浏览器里。
nlc26.evoPlayNote.en: Not a screenshot: the actual file uploaded that night. Click around, and anything you do stays in your own browser.

nlc26.evoClose.zh: 如果我等到想清楚了才动手，这个东西到今天还不存在。先做一个能用的丑东西，让它去见学生，剩下的交给修改。
nlc26.evoClose.en: Had I waited until I knew what I was doing, none of this would exist. Make an ugly thing that runs, put it in front of students, and let revision do the rest.

nlc26.rosterNote.zh: 它们做得很快，但它们不认识你的学生，不知道他们的需求。教师必须不断在创建过程中运用专业知识进行判断。
nlc26.rosterNote.en: They work fast, but they do not know your students, or what those students need. All the way through the building, the teacher has to keep applying professional judgement.

page.nw26.title.en: Nüwa Mends the Sky - Chun Kai Xin

nw26.title.en: Nüwa Mends the Sky: Using AI to Design Chinese Language Games for Self-Directed Learning
nw26.title.zh: 女娲补天：运用AI设计华文游戏，推动自主学习

nw26.dVenue.en: Venue · Bukit View Secondary School, Learning Hub (Level 3)
nw26.dVenue.zh: 地点 · 百德中学学习中心（三楼）

nw26.gapTitle.en: Spotting the gap: how game-based learning drives self-directed learning
nw26.gapTitle.zh: 发现缺口：游戏化学习如何推动自主学习

nw26.gapLede.en: Vocabulary is the building block of language. It has to be learned by repetition, and our students resist this mode of learning.
nw26.gapLede.zh: 词汇是语言的基石，必须靠反复练习来掌握，而学生偏偏抗拒这种学法。

nw26.arcTitle.zh: 动机框架：自我决定理论

nw26.arcLede.en: ARC: autonomy, relatedness, competence. What makes a student choose to practise.
nw26.arcLede.zh: ARC：自主、关联、胜任。学生为什么会主动练习。

nw26.need2.en: I can see myself getting better.

nw26.fill1.en: How VocabSummit fills it: everything is a choice
nw26.fill1.zh: 词山学海怎么补：一切由自己选

nw26.fill2.en: How VocabSummit fills it: progress you can see
nw26.fill2.zh: 词山学海怎么补：看得见的进步

nw26.fill3.en: How VocabSummit fills it: nobody climbs alone
nw26.fill3.zh: 词山学海怎么补：没有人独自攀登

nw26.fill1B.zh: 学习模式还是游戏模式

nw26.fill1D.en: How to build up their camp

nw26.fill1E.zh: 把货币花在哪些道具上

nw26.fill2B.zh: 每个单元板块一枚徽章

nw26.fill3A.en: Classroom climbs, started by the teacher or by the students themselves
nw26.fill3A.zh: 课堂攀登，由老师或学生自己发起

nw26.research.en: Game elements are not effective in themselves. Different elements satisfy different psychological needs: competence, autonomy, relatedness.
nw26.research.zh: 游戏元素本身不会产生效果。不同的元素满足不同的心理需求：胜任、自主、关联。

nw26.researchCite.en: Sailer & Homner, 2020 · The gamification of learning: a meta-analysis · Educational Psychology Review
nw26.researchCite.zh: Sailer & Homner, 2020 · The gamification of learning: a meta-analysis · Educational Psychology Review

nw26.partTwo.en: Mending the sky: building learning games with AI tools, without a coding background
nw26.partTwo.zh: 补天：不会编码，也能用 AI 工具做学习游戏

nw26.stackLede.en: A development team of one. So how does it run five roles?
nw26.stackLede.zh: 一人开发团队，怎么会有五个岗位？

nw26.goalGap.en: Understand how to use Self-Determination Theory (ARC: autonomy, relatedness, competence) to analyse students' learning needs, and fill that gap through game design.
nw26.goalGap.zh: 理解如何以自我决定理论（ARC：自主、关联、胜任）分析学生的学习需求，通过游戏设计补上该缺口

nw26.goal3.en: Publish a game prototype: create your own GitHub repo, copy a small game and publish it live.
nw26.goal3.zh: 发布游戏原型：创建自己的 GitHub Repo，复制一款小游戏并发布上线

page.guide.title.zh: 攀山快答教程 · 郑凯欣

guide.eyebrow.zh: 攀山快答 · 教师改编版

guide.title.en: Make your vocabulary game, step by step
guide.title.zh: 一步一步做出你的词语游戏

guide.sub.en: For after the workshop. Every step shows the real screen; if something goes wrong, see the last two parts.
guide.sub.zh: 工作坊结束后照着做。每一步都附上真实画面；出了问题，看最后两部分。

guide.publishTitle.en: 1 · Copy the game and get a link
guide.publishTitle.zh: 一 · 复制游戏，变成网址

guide.publishLede.en: All on the GitHub website. Nothing to download or upload.
guide.publishLede.zh: 只需在 GitHub 网页上点，不必下载，不必上传。

guide.pub1.en: Open the starter repository. Click the green Use this template (top right) → Create a new repository.
guide.pub1.zh: 打开示范仓库，点右上角绿色的 Use this template → Create a new repository。

guide.pub1Shot.en: Use this template sits at the top right
guide.pub1Shot.zh: Use this template 在页面右上角

guide.pub2.en: Give it an English name with no spaces, e.g. s3-unit1-climb. Keep it Public and click Create repository.
guide.pub2.zh: Repository name 填一个英文名字，不要空格，例如 s3-unit1-climb。保持 Public，按 Create repository。

guide.pub2Shot.en: Only the repository name needs filling in

guide.pub3.en: In your own new repository: Settings (top) → Pages (left) → Source: Deploy from a branch → Branch: main and / (root) → Save.
guide.pub3.zh: 在你自己的新仓库里：上方 Settings → 左边 Pages → Source 选 Deploy from a branch → Branch 选 main 和 / (root) → Save。

guide.pub3Shot.en: Settings → Pages. Once set, Your site is live at … appears at the top
guide.pub3Shot.zh: Settings → Pages。设好之后，上方会出现 Your site is live at …

guide.pub4.en: Wait a minute or two and refresh. When Your site is live at … appears, click Visit site. That link is the one for your students.
guide.pub4.zh: 等一两分钟，刷新这一页，上方出现 Your site is live at … 就成功了。点 Visit site，这个网址就可以发给学生。

guide.wordsTitle.zh: 二 · 换上你自己的词语

guide.wordsLede.en: Claude turns your word list into the format the game reads; then you paste it into GitHub.
guide.wordsLede.zh: 用 Claude 把词语表变成游戏要的格式，再贴回 GitHub。

guide.words1.en: On your repository page: green Code button → Download ZIP → unzip it.
guide.words1.zh: 在你的仓库首页：绿色 Code 按钮 → Download ZIP → 解压。

guide.words1Shot.en: Download ZIP is at the bottom of the Code menu
guide.words1Shot.zh: Download ZIP 在 Code 菜单最下面

guide.words2.en: Open 词语表模板.xlsx and fill in your words and meanings. Leave row 1 alone; eight words or more.
guide.words2.zh: 打开「词语表模板.xlsx」，填上你的词语和释义，第一行不动，至少 8 个。

guide.words3.en: claude.ai → Projects → Create project → name it. Upload every unzipped file and your filled-in sheet, then paste the prompt below.
guide.words3.zh: claude.ai → Projects → Create project → 取个名字。把解压后的所有文件和你填好的表格上传进去，再贴下面这段提示词。

guide.words4.en: Put Claude's my-words.js into the unzipped folder, replacing the old one. Double-click index.html and play a round to check the words.
guide.words4.zh: 把 Claude 给你的 my-words.js 放进解压的资料夹，覆盖原来那个。双击 index.html 先玩一局，确认词语对了。

guide.words5.en: Back in your GitHub repository, click my-words.js, then the pencil icon on the right.
guide.words5.zh: 回到你的 GitHub 仓库，点 my-words.js，再点右边的铅笔图标。

guide.words5Shot.en: The pencil is to the right of Raw
guide.words5Shot.zh: 铅笔图标在 Raw 的右边

guide.words6.en: Select all, delete, paste in what Claude gave you. Click Commit changes… at the top right, then Commit changes again.
guide.words6.zh: 全选、删除，贴上 Claude 给你的内容，按右上角 Commit changes…，再按一次 Commit changes。

guide.words6Shot.en: Commit changes turns green once something has changed
guide.words6Shot.zh: 改了内容之后，Commit changes 才会变绿

guide.words7.en: Wait a minute or two and refresh your game link. Your students now get your words.
guide.words7.zh: 等一两分钟，刷新你的游戏网址，学生就玩到你的词语了。

guide.artLede.en: Three pictures: landscape.jpg behind, wall.jpg the cliff, climber.png the climber.
guide.artLede.zh: 三张图：landscape.jpg 远景、wall.jpg 崖壁、climber.png 攀登者。

guide.art1.en: Make a new picture with ChatGPT and rename it to exactly the same file name.
guide.art1.zh: 用 ChatGPT 生成新图，下载后改成一模一样的文件名。

guide.art2.en: In your repository: Add file → Upload files → drag the picture in → Commit changes. A file with the same name is replaced.
guide.art2.zh: 在你的仓库：Add file → Upload files → 把图拖进去 → Commit changes。同名的图会被替换。

guide.fixTitle.en: 4 · When GitHub gets in the way

guide.fixLede.en: Check here first when you are stuck.

guide.fix1.en: No Settings tab: check the top left shows your own name (yourname / repository). The starter is not yours, so it has no Settings. On a small screen, Settings is folded into the ··· at the end of the tab row.
guide.fix1.zh: 找不到 Settings：先看左上角是不是你自己的名字（你的名字 / 仓库名）。示范仓库不是你的，没有 Settings。屏幕小的话，Settings 会收进上方那排标签最后的「···」里。

guide.fix2.en: The link shows 404: Pages takes a minute or two at first. If it still fails, check Settings → Pages says main and / (root), and that index.html sits at the top of the repository, not inside a folder.
guide.fix2.zh: 网址打开是 404：刚开 Pages 要等一两分钟。还是不行，回 Settings → Pages 看是不是 main 和 / (root)，并确认 index.html 在仓库最外层，不在任何资料夹里。

guide.fix3.en: Changed it but the link has not: open the Actions tab. A yellow dot is still publishing, a green tick is done, red or ! has failed. Once done, hard refresh (Windows Ctrl + F5, Mac Cmd + Shift + R).
guide.fix3.zh: 改了但网址没变：点上方 Actions。黄色圆点是还在发布，绿色勾是好了，红色或感叹号是失败。好了之后强制刷新（Windows Ctrl + F5，Mac Cmd + Shift + R）。

guide.fix3Shot.zh: Actions：每一次改动都会发布一次

guide.fix4.en: The game is blank or says the word list has a problem: it names the line. Almost always a missing comma, quote or brace. Fix that line in my-words.js with the pencil.
guide.fix4.zh: 游戏一片空白或说词语表有问题：画面会写出第几行错了，九成是少了逗号、引号或大括号。回到 my-words.js 用铅笔改那一行。

guide.rollbackNav.en: 5 · Go back to a version that worked
guide.rollbackNav.zh: 五 · 退回上一个好的版本

guide.rollbackTitle.en: 5 · Broke it: go back to a version that worked
guide.rollbackTitle.zh: 五 · 改坏了：退回上一个好的版本

guide.rollbackLede.en: The GitHub website has no one-click undo, but every old version is kept. Copy the good one back. If several files broke, do this for each.
guide.rollbackLede.zh: GitHub 网页没有「一键退回」，但每一个旧版本都留着，复制回来就行。改坏了几个文件，就每个文件做一次。

guide.back1.en: Open the broken file (e.g. my-words.js) and click History. Each row is one change, newest at the top.
guide.back1.zh: 打开改坏的文件（例如 my-words.js），点右上方 History。每一行是一次改动，最新的在最上面。

guide.back1Shot.en: History: every change to this file
guide.back1Shot.zh: History：这个文件的每一次改动

guide.back2.en: Find the last row that still worked and click the middle icon on its right (View file at this point). Copy the whole file with the copy icon beside Raw.
guide.back2.zh: 找到最后一次还正常的那一行，点右边中间的图标（View file at this point），就会看到当时的内容。按 Raw 旁边的复制图标，整份复制。

guide.back2Shot.en: The file as it was. The copy icon is right of Raw
guide.back2Shot.zh: 旧版本的文件。复制图标在 Raw 右边

guide.back3.en: Go back to the current file, click the pencil, select all, delete, paste, Commit changes.
guide.back3.zh: 回到现在的文件，点铅笔，全选、删除，贴上刚才复制的内容，Commit changes。

guide.back4.en: Wait a minute or two and refresh the link. You are back on that version, and the broken one is still in History.
guide.back4.zh: 等一两分钟刷新网址，就回到那个版本了。旧的坏版本也还留在 History 里，不会丢。

nw26.voice3.zh: 「我身边的人，下了课没人用华文。」
nw26.voice3.en: “Nobody close to me uses Chinese outside class.”

nw26.s1T1.zh: 打开我的示范项目 → 右上角绿色的 Use this template → Create a new repository。
nw26.s1T1.en: Open my starter → the green Use this template (top right) → Create a new repository.

nw26.s1T2.zh: 仓库名用英文、不要空格，例如 s3-unit1-climb → 保持 Public → Create repository。所有文件一次复制好，不必下载，也不必上传。
nw26.s1T2.en: Name it in English with no spaces, e.g. s3-unit1-climb → keep Public → Create repository. Every file is copied in one go: nothing to download or upload.

nw26.s1P6.zh: https://你的用户名.github.io/你的仓库名/ 活了。里面还是我的示范词语，但它已经是一个学生打得开的网址。到这里就算完成。
nw26.s1P6.en: https://yourusername.github.io/your-repository-name/ is live. The words in it are still mine, but it is already a link a student can open. That is this stage finished.

nw26.s2Zip.zh: 在你的新仓库：绿色 Code 按钮 → Download ZIP → 解压。
nw26.s2Zip.en: In your new repository: green Code button → Download ZIP → unzip.

nlc26.key1.zh: 网址活了，用的是示范游戏原件
nlc26.key1.en: Your link is live, still running the starter game as it came

nlc26.key2.zh: 网址上用的已经是我的教学内容
nlc26.key2.en: The link now runs your own teaching content

nlc26.key3.zh: 换了图，网址已经有我重新设计的图像
nlc26.key3.en: New pictures: the link shows artwork you redesigned

nlc26.key4.zh: 换了玩法，做出一款新的游戏
nlc26.key4.en: A new way to play: a different game of your own
